# Sanctions (SAN)

The fines the General Tax Law sets for invoicing breaches and for billing software that does not comply.

Rules page: https://docs.beel.es/rules/sanctions

"Checked by: Your integration" or "The issuing business" means BeeL. does not enforce the rule, beyond any error codes it lists: the integration has to.

## SAN-001

**Invoice only with compliant, unaltered software**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: medium · Checked by: The issuing business. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

Issue invoices only with a billing system that meets the regulation and has not been altered. Holding software that does not is an infringement of its own, fined 50,000 € per financial year.

**Why:** The fine applies for merely having the software, whatever it was used for.

**Applies to:** Every business subject to the billing-system regulation.

**Legal basis:**

- Ley 58/2003 General Tributaria, art. 201 bis.2 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2003-23186#a201bis
- Ley 58/2003 General Tributaria, art. 201 bis.4 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2003-23186#a201bis

**Incorrect:** Keeping a tool that edits or deletes issued invoices next to the invoicing flow.

**Correct:** Issuing, correcting and voiding only through documents the system records.

**Related:** LIF-001, SAN-002

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/SAN-001.md

## SAN-002

**Invoicing breaches are fined in proportion to the operations**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: medium · Checked by: The issuing business. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

Issuing, delivering, correcting and keeping invoices are obligations; breaking them is fined at 1 % of the operations involved, 2 % when invoices were not issued or kept, and up to 75 % when they carry false data.

**Why:** A flow that skips invoices, or corrects them by issuing new ones with altered data, turns into a fine proportional to the amounts involved.

**Applies to:** Every business with invoicing obligations.

**Legal basis:**

- Ley 58/2003 General Tributaria, art. 201.1 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2003-23186#a201
- Ley 58/2003 General Tributaria, art. 201.2 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2003-23186#a201

**Incorrect:** Leaving sales without an invoice, or fixing a mistake by issuing a second invoice for the same sale.

**Correct:** Invoicing every operation and fixing mistakes with a corrective invoice.

**Related:** SAN-001, CNT-001, COR-001

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/SAN-002.md
